title: TUI: answer a stopped run or question in a detail pane
lead: Owner decision #45 owner.questions: a stopped slice lands in Needs you, the owner answers in ork, ork resumes the role. Today a stop shows only a status line and the answer is the CLI 'ork answer RUN TEXT'. Decided: #99 ui.answer-ui (a detail pane on the row, plus a Questions tab). Depends on S25.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision #45 owner.questions: a stopped slice lands in Needs you, the owner answers in ork, ork resumes the role. Today a stop shows only a status line and the answer is the CLI 'ork answer RUN TEXT'. Decided: #99 ui.answer-ui (a detail pane on the row, plus a Questions tab). Depends on S25.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - internal/tui (detail pane, text input), internal/daemon (structured question: stop reason, options, role), internal/engine as needed, tests, goldens, docs.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Enter on a Needs-you engine row opens a pane with the full stop reason, any options and a text field.
- Submitting runs the equivalent of ork answer RUN TEXT and the row updates; the command is shown first.
- Open design points to ask the owner before building: how the engine marks a stop as a question with options.
